assessments.name: Daily Quizzes
assessments.description: Each day that we meet in class in person, we will have a very brief (5 min) quiz at either the beginning or the end of the class period.

assessments.name: Exam 1
assessments.description: This exam will cover the first major unit of the course: History.

assessments.name: Exam 2
assessments.description: Covers the second major unit of the course: Python.

assessments.name: Final Project
assessments.description: This involves three components: code submission, presentation, and oral exam.

course_catalog_description: A study of the fundamentals of writing computer programs and problem-solving, using structured and object-oriented techniques. Intended for future majors and minors in Computer Science and minors in Game Development.

course_learning_goals.detail: knowledge of a basic computer system architecture.
a problem solving methodology and apply it to writng programs in C#.
an understanding of the basic C# language concepts.
your ability to use a C# editor and debugger.
